aggregation._comment: Source weights control the relative influence of each listening source when computing the final profile vector. They are intentionally equal starting points — not performance claims. Tune after offline evaluation (Phase 3).
aggregation._comment_decay: Exponential decay: weight = exp(-lambda * age_days). Lambda = 0.08/day → half-life ≈ 8.7 days. Applied to 'recent' and 'liked' sources where timestamps are available. Missing timestamps receive neutral weight 1.0 (not discarded).
aggregation._comment_liked_decay: Liked/saved tracks also receive mild temporal decay when added_at is available, using a much slower lambda so long-ago saves still count but very recent saves are weighted slightly higher.
aggregation._comment_frequency: interaction_count (replay frequency from recently_played pagination) scales within-source weight. Capped to prevent a single obsessively-replayed track from dominating the profile.
aggregation._comment_confidence: Minimum track counts to assign a profile quality status. These thresholds apply to the count of catalog-matched tracks (matched + ambiguous), not raw Spotify tracks.
aggregation._comment_precedence: Cross-source deduplication precedence when building taste signals for the ML path. A catalog track that appears in multiple sources is assigned to exactly one source group using this order.
aggregation._comment_decay_sources: Which source groups receive temporal decay. 'manual' is excluded because in-app likes have no meaningful recency ordering.
